author: Forbes
description:
Forbes' Maggie McGrath sits down with personal finance expert and HerMoney founder Jean Chatzky to discuss her new book, The Forever Paycheck. Chatzky dives into the behavioral psychology  behind why retirees are often paralyzed by the fear of spending their hard-earned savings and sharing practical strategies to build a guaranteed stream of income for life. Beyond retirement advice, Chatzky reflects on her own unconventional career journey—from skipping out on an MBA to learn Wall Street basics, to her 25-year run on The Today Show—and shares how her company continues to help women build confidence through financial literacy.

author: Forbes
description:
New Balance has gone from “dad shoe” to global cultural force. But how do you stay authentic once you've made it?

In this episode of A Different Take, host Linda Boff looks at New Balance's next challenge with Klutch Athletic CEO & Founder Rich Paul, New Balance CMO & Brand President Chris Davis, five-time Olympic medalist Gabby Thomas, Kith Founder, CEO & Creative Director Ronnie Fieg, and Complex Associate Editor Matt Welty.

From athlete partnerships and cultural relevance to growth, product, and the power of staying fiercely independent, they unpack what it takes to get bigger without becoming something you're not.
